verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Freddy AI doing lead intent scoring, deal recommendations and email drafting, plus a REST API. None of this documents users issuing natural-language commands to operate the product; these are adjacent AI features and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
